summary: Bidirectional alignment fails on three material coverage holes: source-hash declaration-order independence is only vacuously probed, same_zone_preferred local-preferred selection with both local and remote eligible targets is unasserted, and control-frame sequence-reuse rejection is asserted under a quorum that a single session can never satisfy. Instruction shape, docs boundary, and reverse discoverability of the 47 graded behaviors are otherwise sound.

evidence.observation: Exactly 20 concise bullets: repair/complete the mixed Go/C++/Bash/Python plane under /app/sovereign-lb; build graded binaries via bin/build; validate complete desired docs; fence revision/idempotency; compile immutable digests; run the framed control protocol; quorum prepare/activate without damaging LKG; persist/recover authority; proxy real TCP with timeouts/backpressure/PROXY v2; eligibility via admin/health/passive/zone/fail-open/drain; bounded readiness/status/rollout/metrics/audit; 24-node three-zone lab; exclusions; follow /app/sovereign-lb/docs with idempotent ops.

Desired document schema, allowed balancing/zone/fail_open enums, incarnation/ownership rules, canonical ordering, and explicit statement that source hash uses canonical eligible identity order so declaration order cannot change selection; fail_open is not a soft cross-zone override while local normally-eligible targets remain.

Eligibility algorithm: normally-eligible set, same_zone_preferred local-only while local nonempty, fail_open empty-set fallback that never includes admin-disabled/expired-drain targets, RR/LC/source-hash selection over canonical identities, stream buffer/backpressure/half-close/timeouts, single PROXY v2 header, drain ownership.

4-byte BE length-prefixed canonical JSON frames; hello/prepare/prepared/rejected/activate/active/status envelopes; sequence/session/node fences; torn frames have no state effect; status is bidirectional, bounded, and must not advance authority.
Build/lab entrypoints, apply HTTP outcomes 200/202/409/422/400, revision/idempotency conflict matrix, graceful shutdown notes.
GET /ready, /v1/status (including rollout_present and connection-count summaries), /v1/audit, /metrics with ban on high-cardinality generation= labels.

Atomic temp/rename generation layout, authority.json accepted_revision/accepted_digest/idempotency, generation-%020d padding, CURRENT fallback to highest verified generation, checkpoint verify-before-publish.
Rollout phases, fenced prepare/activate counting, rejection/deadline leaves preceding active generation untouched, no reuse of failed generation numbers.
Authority boundaries, control/dataplane lifecycle, resource bounds, explicit product exclusions. Ordinary architecture doc, not a repair map.
Five loopback backends and 24-node/3-zone inventory as deterministic lab fixtures.

47 pytest behaviors (4 P2P / 43 F2P) driving build artifacts, HTTP apply/status/ready/audit/metrics, framed control probes, lab TCP backends, and durable state under temp roots. No callable end-to-end solver. Notable gaps: source-hash reorder test asserts only intra-apply affinity; no local+remote same_zone selection assertion; sequence-reuse half of session fence test uses activate_quorum=2 with one session.
Creates /logs/verifier at runtime, runs pytest on test_outputs.py, writes binary reward 0/1 after pytest.

Classification-only map: 4 P2P + 43 F2P against REQ_AUTHORITY/ROLLOUT/CANONICAL/STREAM/READINESS/PROTOCOL/ELIGIBILITY/RECOVERY/PUBLIC. Used only to label ownership; requirements rebuilt from instruction and docs.

Any material untested/vacuous requirement or grading-relevant ambiguity yields REVISE; MEDIUM blocks when it can change pass/fail or documented stable-interface compliance; exhaustiveness required before verdict.

Instruction owns the engineering ask; docs may hold protocol/schema/eligibility detail; material requirements must be discoverable and meaningfully tested; vacuous preservation/selection probes are defects.

findings.why_it_matters: configuration.md states source hash maps over canonical eligible identities so declaration order cannot change selection. The named reorder test appends a target, reverses declaration once, applies that single document, and only asserts four connections from one client hit the same backend. A declaration-order hash also yields stable affinity within one ordering, so the documented order-independence invariant is not observed and incorrect solvers can still pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Drive two applies that differ only by target declaration order (same identity set), collect source-hash selections for a fixed client, and assert identical chosen target identity across both orders; keep affinity assertions secondary.
findings.regression_risk: Low if the new assertion stays behavioral on lab events/backends and does not hard-code oracle file layout.

findings.criterion: material eligibility requirement covered by a meaningful assertion
findings.why_it_matters: Docs require that under same_zone_preferred, remote normally-eligible targets are never chosen while the local normally-eligible set is nonempty, and that fail_open is not a soft cross-zone override in that case. Existing coverage only checks remote-only + fail_open=false (empty after zone filter). Round-robin deliberately switches to cross_zone to hit both backends. A solver that still selects remotes while local targets remain eligible can pass every current test.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add an F2P case with same_zone_preferred, fail_open true or false, both local and remote normally-eligible targets present, and assert all selections stay in the dataplane local zone.
findings.regression_risk: Low; complements rather than weakens the remote-only no-forward case.

findings.criterion: F2P/protocol fence assertion must be able to fail if the contract is violated
findings.why_it_matters: control-protocol.md rejects reuse of a sequence with different content without advancing authority. The second half of the session-fence test raises prepare/activate quorum to 2 while only one control session exists, then sends a conflicting sequence reuse and waits for non-active rollout. Quorum 2 can never be met with one session, so wait_rollout_not_active succeeds whether or not sequence reuse is fenced. Stale-session rejection in the first half remains meaningful; sequence-reuse is vacuous.
findings.minimal_remediation: Probe sequence reuse under a reachable quorum (for example quorum 1 with a single valid session): accept one prepared, then reuse the same sequence with different body and assert the rollout still cannot reach active / acknowledgement is rejected.
findings.regression_risk: Low if stale-session coverage is preserved alongside a non-vacuous sequence-reuse probe.

findings.criterion: canonical JSON shape graded beyond self-digest match
findings.why_it_matters: Digest equality to stored snapshot bytes does not independently assert sorted keys / no insignificant whitespace. Interop via matching prepare/activate digests partially constrains both sides, so this is advisory rather than blocking.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optionally re-canonicalize snapshot JSON in the verifier and assert byte identity, or compare against an independently computed canonical digest.
findings.regression_risk: Medium if the assertion over-fits a particular serializer.

findings.criterion: documented incarnation re-register rule vs field persistence
findings.why_it_matters: The test only applies incarnation=2 and reads it back from the snapshot; it does not exercise remove/re-add with a non-increasing incarnation or reject that case. Treat as advisory unless validation of that rule is intended to be graded.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either add a 422 path for non-increasing incarnation on logical re-add, or rename/narrow the requirement if it is operator guidance only.

findings.criterion: negative product exclusions need not be positively tested
findings.why_it_matters: No HTTP routing / WAF / DNS / firewall / cloud-provisioning exclusions are stated but not directly asserted. Acceptable as scope fences; advisory only.
findings.minimal_remediation: None required for Quality Interlock unless product wants explicit absence probes.

do_not_change: Do not weaken documented zone/fail_open/source-hash/control-fence contracts to match vacuous tests
Do not convert docs into a hidden repair map or dump per-test bullets into instruction.md
Do not edit solution/oracle solely to satisfy new assertions without legitimate public behavior
